definitions.gloss: Hōnen (1133–1212), founder of the Jōdo sect
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist monk of the late Heian and early Kamakura periods who founded the Jōdo (Pure Land) sect. He taught that anyone, not just monks or the learned, could be reborn in Amida Buddha's Pure Land by sincerely chanting the nenbutsu, the invocation of Amida's name.

examples.english: Hōnen taught that anyone could be saved simply by chanting the nenbutsu.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- His teaching of {専修念仏|せんじゅねんぶつ}, relying on the nenbutsu alone, opened Buddhism to ordinary people and was opposed by the established temples; he was exiled late in life
- {知恩院|ちおんいん} in Kyoto is the head temple of his sect

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{浄土宗|じょうどしゅう}→浄土宗：31849_joudoshuu⟧: the Jōdo sect he founded
- {親鸞|しんらん}: his disciple, founder of {浄土真宗|じょうどしんしゅう}
- ⟦{念仏|ねんぶつ}→念仏：12850_nenbutsu⟧: chanting Amida Buddha's name
